review_candidates.title: Network Engineer - Security & Infrastructure
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This is a hands-on role for a network professional who enjoys troubleshooting, solving problems, working with a variety of technologies, and expanding their experience in both network engineering and cybersecurity. Reporting to the Network Architecture & Security Manager, you will help design, implement, maintain, monitor, and secure our network infrastructure while participating in projects that improve reliability, performance, security, and efficiency. What We Are Looking For At least 5 years
eligibility_evidence: Location & Hybrid Schedule: Columbus, Ohio – Hybrid This is not a fully remote position .
This role requires working onsite at our Columbus-area Home Office a minimum of three days per week , with the opportunity to work remotely up to two days per week.
Candidates should live within reasonable commuting distance of Columbus, Ohio, or be willing to relocate to the Columbus area.
